thread:
Samira (Sales Eng): Heads-up — Greenline wants a 2-week trial POC. They want a private test env in their US VPC, reserved performance for 4xA100-equivalent GPUs during peak hours, plus occasional burst to 8 GPUs. Also asked for SOC2 attestation, KMS/HSM support, and a capability matrix. Can we provision and give a non-binding quote by EOD tomorrow?

Alex (AE): Got it. Do they need data residency guarantees beyond US regions (e.g., contract clause)? Also need an idea of cost so I can set expectations.

Samira (Sales Eng): They want contract language that ensures data stays in US and deletes logs after 30 days for PII. Good to have draft numbers to share now.

Priya (SRE): We can stand up a private trial in their VPC using our Private flow, timeline ~48h for initial infra + VPN peering, longer if they want HSM integration. Steps for minimal test env:
```
1) Create a dedicated subnet in their VPC
2) Provide a peering agent and a short-lived IAM role
3) Deploy 2 instances with 2 GPUs each, add autoscaler config
```
I'll need Greenline contact + CIDR and desired windows for burst.

Ben (Solutions): I uploaded the capability matrix and example RFI answers: attachment: greenline_capability_matrix_v1.xlsx and attachment: rfi_answers_greenline_v1.pdf. The matrix highlights our model catalog, quantization options, KV caching, and routing/fallback features.

Alex (AE): Thanks Ben. Pricing ask: can we give a ballpark? Samira — do we want to offer a promo rate for first 2 weeks?

Samira (Sales Eng): Yes, please provide a promo: 50% off compute for the first 2 weeks and waive onboarding fee. We need a line item for reserved baseline (4 GPUs) + burst capacity pricing per GPU-hour.

Priya (SRE): Ballpark, non-binding: baseline reserved infra for 4xA100-equivalent ~ $18k/month (on reserved commit), burst hourly ~ $15/GPU-hour. Networking/egress is extra per TB. For 2-week trial with 50% off compute it's ~ $2.3k estimate. This assumes no on-prem HSM provisioning — HSM integration adds a 5–7 day lead and engineering time.

Ben (Solutions): Also note: SOC2 type II report available, we'll attach the redacted report. For HSM we support customer-managed keys via KMS + optional HSM, require signing an addendum and SOW for key custody.

Alex (AE): Perfect. Samira — I'll send the pricing + capability matrix and note the HSM lead time. Samira — can you confirm the contact and CIDR?

Samira (Sales Eng): Contact is jordan@greenline.com, CIDR 10.52.0.0/20. Jordan asked if we can provide sample deploy commands for their infra team. Priya — can we paste a minimal example they can run?

Priya (SRE): Sure — minimal example for the peering agent (they'll run on their side):
```bash
# run on Greenline bastion
curl -X POST https://peering.redwood.ai/v1/request -d '{"cidr":"10.52.0.0/20","env":"greenline-trial"}' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
# we will reply with config and a presigned agent image
```
I'll follow up in email with the MFA/KMS steps.

Samira (Sales Eng): Great — I'll draft the reply to Jordan with attachments and the non-binding quote. Alex — if you can confirm commercial approve, I'll send.

Alex (AE): I approve the promo and numbers. I'll add a commercial note: trial limited to 2 weeks, max burst 8 GPUs, support included at standard trial level.

deploy-bot: Provisioning note — trial workspace 'greenline-trial' queued. ETA 47 hours. :rocket:
